name: Gearbox shaft axial end float
description: Axial stack setting the end float of a shaft carried on two deep-groove ball bearings, located by a spacer and a ground shim inside a housing bore. End float must stay positive (no axial preload on the bearings) and bounded (no excessive play).

contributors.name: HOUSING_BORE_DEPTH
contributors.note: Bored on a horizontal machining centre. Mean shift assumed at 0.3 sigma for thermal drift across a shift.

contributors.name: BEARING_1_WIDTH
contributors.note: Supplier grinds to the upper half of the width band, so the distribution is skewed high rather than normal.

contributors.name: SPACER_LENGTH
contributors.note: Turned and faced, both ends in one setup.

contributors.name: BEARING_2_WIDTH
contributors.note: Same supplier and batch behaviour as bearing 1.

contributors.name: RETAINING_SHIM
contributors.note: Sheet stock sorted to thickness bands, so thickness is close to uniform inside a band.
